Dennis Fleming, a son of one of our old members, showed promise of bigger things in this event. He is only 16 and with an increase in age and weight, should improve considerably.
As for the Juniors, we have a number of very promising lads. Dennis Fleming, Peter Drew and Arthur Allen in the Shot.
Our junior members also gained several award, with Dennis Fleming winning the Discus, and being second in the Javelin. His brother, Alan, was also second in the Long Jump, and G.
Allen also gained a couple of third places in the Javelin and Weight, and then in the final event we had first two placings in the Discus, with Alan Dunn and Dennis Fleming.
Arthur Bruce won the 1 Mile, and although the S.L.H. boys won the Relay, we picked up some useful points in the Field Events through the help of Alan Dunn, Dennis Fleming and A.

The Juniors are all showing promise, but we have missed Dennis Fleming, who is now in the R.A.F. Arthur Allen has, however, taken his place as our best Junior Javelin thrower, and he is to be congratulated on gaining a standard in the Senior Club Championship.
Don Maclean ran his best race to date in finishing 2nd in the Senior 1 mile which was won in 4 min. 19.6 secs. D.

Bare, our Nigerian member, won the High Jump with 5ft. 6ins., while Dennis Fleming was 2nd in the Javelin with a throw of 160ft. 7½ins., and it is a pity that he cannot turn out more frequently in these matches.

Jones in the High Jump while Dennis Fleming threw for the Police in the Javelin Throw, and it was interesting to note that the Weight was won with 41ft. 11in., which puts our new member Gaworski in a favourable light.
Gaworski won the Discus and was 2nd in the Weight. Dennis Fleming was 1st in the Javelin, with 151ft. 2ins., and D.

McMullen was 3rd in the 2 mile walk and Dennis Fleming was placed 3rd in the Javelin Throw. Basil Walden, Pete Cornish and Alan Law all qualified for the 100 yds. final, but could not get placed in the first three, and Jim Heathfield also reached the 440 final.
Gaworski was 1st in both the Weight and Discus, and is improving each time out, while Dennis Fleming won the Javelin Throw with 166ft., with D.
Day, 5ft. 4ins., and this placed us 4th in the team result. We were also 4th in the Javelin Throw, with Dennis Fleming and D.

Bare was unlucky in the High Jump, as although he cleared 5ft. 9ins., which was the height which gained 2nd place, owing to the larger number of failures, he was eventually placed 6th. Dennis Fleming was 5th in the Javelin with a throw of 164ft. 6ins., and G.
Gaworski won the Discus with 132ft., while Dennis Fleming was third in the Javelin with 157ft. 5ins., and Percy Luxon was 4th in the Hop, Step and Jump, and K.
Key win the handicap, with Percy Luxon second and Dennis Fleming third. The Discus Throw handicap was won by Dave Ansell, with D.
